### Fixed
- **The kagent line re-pins to `v0.11.0-gs.4`** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37763, giantswarm/giantswarm#37010): the line's fourth release (commit `ca399a3a`; the upstream pin stays kagent-dev/kagent `main` @ `6a6b54ff`) carries one more patch, giantswarm/kagent-upstream#15 — the A2A gateway fails a task whose dispatch to the AgentInstance runtime fails (a failing dial, a failing ingester start, or a runtime stream that errors before its first event) instead of leaving it `TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED` for good, which kept it as the instance's active task, refused every later message as a conflict and showed every client a turn that never ends; a submitted task the runtime does not know is failed by the reconciler after the one-minute dispatch grace period. `kagent.tag` moves to `0.11.0-gs.4` (the controller and UI image build) and `kagent.harness.image` to the `gs.4` Go ADK index digest `sha256:6e510b241e2d000b7d10879c9fde3dd34a37879854278f0a5d386426049a88bf` (meta and connectivity charts); `components.kagent`/`components.kagent-crds` keep the range `>=0.11.0-gs.1 <0.11.1-0`. `examples/customer-bom.yaml` and `tests/verify-kagent-crds.py` (`KAGENT_LINE_REF`) move with the pin. An installation on the 4.x line rolls the kagent controller, UI and the platform Harness to the new build on its next reconcile; the lab proof of the released chart is the audit's next step (giantswarm/giantswarm#37763). `make verify-wiring`'s whole-render comparison against `origin/main` leaves image references out, so a re-pin — which moves `kagent.harness.image` by design — no longer trips it.
